The Molossi

A militarized Gulf Coast power bloc commanded by Marcus Georgio in Compromised.

Connectionnot applicable Continuitydivision transmedia Canon scopeofficial transmedia Verificationsource reviewed Reviewed2026-07-27

A competing protector force

The Molossi arrive as a heavily organized alternative to the Division's small cell, offering security to communities threatened by the Reborn. [1]

Power under pressure

Their expansion cannot be read simply as an independent takeover: the novel later establishes that rogue leverage against Georgio is driving the movement into the region. [1]

Claim ledger

Every factual statement below must retain at least one traceable source.

  1. confirmed

    Compromised describes the Molossi as a private army assembled around Dallas-Fort Worth by Marcus Georgio after the pandemic, with local JTF elements rallying to it. [1]

  2. confirmed

    The Molossi move into Gulf Coast refinery communities under the language of protection while the rogue cell pressures Georgio to expand their control. [1]
